title: Mobile Developer (Flutter / React Native)
summary: A cross-platform mobile developer builds one app that runs on both Android and iPhone, using Flutter or React Native. They work in a mobile or product team and ship to both the Play Store and the App Store.
dailyDuties: Build screens and features in Flutter or React Native
Integrate APIs and handle offline states
Manage app state with Riverpod, Bloc, Provider or Redux
Fix native Android and iOS build issues
Raise pull requests and review teammates' code
Release builds to both the Play Store and the App Store

skills.expectation: Build a production app in a cross-platform framework
Build a production app in a cross-platform framework
Integrate APIs and handle offline states
Use Riverpod, Bloc, Provider or Redux with a clear app architecture
Release to both Play Store and App Store
Work with branches and pull requests

groups.label: A cross-platform framework (Flutter or React Native)
